title: Assistant/Associate/Full Teaching Professor - Department of Economics
description:
Assistant/Associate/Full Teaching Professor - Department of
Economics

About the Opportunity

The College of Social Sciences and
Humanities and its ten tenure units form Northeastern's hub
for humanistic and social scientific inquiry, an intellectual
community that is human-centered, public-facing, and globally
minded. The college's research, teaching, and engagement extend
across the university and to governmental and non-governmental
bodies, cultural institutions, and industry partners around the
world. We seek scholars with a record of excellence in teaching
that cultivates critical thinking, ethical reasoning, and
independent judgment.

The Department of
Economics in the College of Social Sciences and Humanities
seeks to fill two (2) full-time non-tenure-track faculty positions
at the rank of Assistant Teaching Professor, Associate Teaching
Professor, or Full Teaching Professor.

The field of teaching specialization is open, with preference given
to international economics, AI and economics, health economics and
environmental economics. In addition to undergraduate instruction,
the department seeks candidates who can also contribute to
graduate-level courses.

Secondary teaching interests that would further strengthen an
application include machine learning, computational economics, or
data-intensive methods, particularly where these areas complement
modern quantitative approaches.

Successful candidates must demonstrate a strong commitment to
teaching excellence, provide evidence of teaching that connects
economics to large social questions from multiple viewpoints, and a
willingness to contribute meaningfully to both the undergraduate
and graduate teaching missions of the department.

This is an academic year teaching faculty position with
opportunities for promotion through an established track from
Assistant Teaching Professor to Associate Teaching Professor to
Full Teaching Professor. The appointment will be on Northeastern's
Boston campus. This is a full time, benefits-eligible position with
an expected start date of mid-August 2027.

Responsibilities:

Duties include a teaching load of six courses for the academic
year. Student advising, professional development, and service
activities are also expected.

Qualifications:


Ph.D. in Economics or a related field in hand by the employment
start date is required.
The successful candidate should have a strong record of
exemplary teaching and/or demonstrate sufficient promise.
Candidates seeking appointment at the Associate Teaching
Professor level should already hold a position at the rank of
Associate Teaching Professor or have a comparable level of
experience. Candidates seeking appointment at the Full Teaching
Professor level should already hold a position at the rank of Full
Teaching Professor or have a comparable level of experience.



Documents to Submit:

Applicants should submit a cover letter that addresses their
interest in and qualifications for the position, a curriculum
vitae, a teaching statement, sample syllabi, teaching evaluations,
and names and contact information for at least three professional
references from whom letters of reference can be solicited as
needed.

The teaching statement should summarize your past instructional and
mentorship experiences, your pedagogical philosophy, and what you
would like to teach at Northeastern. Please highlight any
pedagogical innovations, experiential learning activities, or
strategies for teaching a global student population.

Review of applications will begin immediately and will continue
until the positions are filled.

Please address questions to Associate Teaching Professor Jill
Dupree, Search Committee Chair, at j.dupree@northeastern.edu.

Position Type

Academic

Additional Information

Northeastern University considers factors such as candidate work
experience, education and skills when extending an offer.

Northeastern has a comprehensive benefits package for benefit
eligible employees. This includes medical, vision, dental, paid
time off, tuition assistance, wellness & life, retirement- as
well as commuting & transportation. Visit https://hr.northeastern.edu/benefits/ for
more information.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply and will receive
consideration for employment without regard to race, religion,
color, national origin, age, sex, sexual orientation, disability
status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable
law.

Pay Range:

Assistant Teaching Professor: $67,000.00 - $83,000.00 | Associate
Teaching Professor: $83,000.00 - $94,000.00 | Teaching Professor:
$92,000.00 - $115,000.00

With the pay range(s) shown above, the starting salary will depend
on several factors, which may include your education, experience,
location, knowledge and expertise, and skills as well as a pay
comparison to similarly-situated employees already in the role.
Salary ranges are reviewed regularly and are subject to
change.



To apply, visit https://northeastern.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/en-US/careers/job/Boston-MA-Main-Campus/Assistant-Associate-Full-Teaching-Professor---Department-of-Economics_R143237
